title: Flam
summary: FLAM, noun A freak or whim; also, a falsehood; a lie; an illusory pretext; deception; delusion. Lies immortalized and consigned over as a perpetual abuse and flam upon posterity. FLAM, verb transitive

inlines.v: FLAM, noun A freak or whim; also, a falsehood; a lie; an illusory pretext; deception; delusion. Lies immortalized and consigned over as a perpetual abuse and flam upon posterity. FLAM, verb transitive To deceive with falsehood; to delude.
